_comment: HUMAN-PLAY FETCH: TARGETS + HOLD (USER 2026-11-14: "Human play doesn't need to keep the hold, at least by default", "maybe the right way to do this is to allow deferring the fetch in the choice dialog?", "I would be okay with it being on all of the time"). In human play a zero-mana one-life fetchland's land drop is one plan per legal target (resolved on play; widened past the provider's narrowed list by WidenHumanFetchTargets) PLUS one hold plan (kFetchHoldTarget): the fetchland enters uncracked, its activation available later.
The bare land drop asks Mountain / Sacred Foundry / hold: three fetch variants.
